title: MENS Corpus Pipeline Audit & Golden Example Repair — 2026-05-13
summary: Audit of 56 golden Vox examples; 24 initially failing type-checker, all fixed; categorizes 15 root-cause classes; reports corpus pipeline results (19,930 training pairs).
notes: Audit report documenting findings and fixes. Categories 1-15 are compiler limitations and workarounds. Pipeline results section reports metrics. Surfaces compiler issues (Option[T] inference, Unit literal, db.Table.filter) for future work. Supporting research, not a decision.
